column1: # MINI00.BZ: the "look this way" mini-game (こっちむいてホイ, from the MOOD UP GAME).
# Game overlay: loads at 0x00280000. Same format as translations.tsv, plus layout boxes:
#   box <TAB> table offset,  then one "|" line per screen line with {color} tags,  then endbox.
#   Colors: {0} black, {3} red, {4} blue, {5} green. {c,h,mask} = color c, flashes color h while
#   the buttons in 'mask' are held (used by control hints). Lines are centered automatically and the
#   box grows to fit. See tools\textpatch.cs for details.
# Full list of this overlay's text: notes\script-MINI00.tsv

column4: title box. "Look this way, hoi!": a Japanese pointing game
label before the hearts (4 letters, like the status panel)

column1: # Instructions: "Point the same way as your Tamagotchi!"
box
|{0}POINT THE {5}SAME
|{5}WAY {0}AS YOUR
|{4}TAMAGOTCHI{0}!
endbox
# Controls hint, bottom right. Each line flashes red while its direction is held.
# In the bold font < and > are arrows. The original box already reaches the screen's right edge,
# so keep these lines to 10 letters or fewer. Left-aligned so the left arrow sits at the box's left
# edge and the right arrow at its right edge.
box
endbox
